_note: Simple set plays per map, 5 attack and 5 defense. None needs a lineup: all util is thrown freehand. If you add a play that needs a lineup, set "lineup": true and the page adds (lineup) to its name. Each step names a job (slot) and the kinds of utility it wants; the page fills in who does it and the ability for their agent. Slots: controller, initiator, duelist, sentinel, fifth (whoever is left over). Change callouts to the ones your squad uses.

Haven.name: A split: Long + Short
Haven.idea: Hit A from Long and Short (Sewer) together so A gets caught from two sides.

steps.do: smoke Heaven and A Link (CT) as Long and Short go
util onto A site from Long, call what you see
first in through Long, clear Hell and default
come through Short (Sewer) on the same call, check Hell
trap A Lobby behind you for the flank, then join for the post-plant

Haven.after: Plant default. Post-plant from Long and Short, one player watching A Link.

Haven.name: C Long execute
Haven.idea: Five through C Long with Garage cut off.

steps.do: smoke C Link (CT) and the Garage door
clear Logs and the C site corners from C Long
trade the duelist, clear Cubby and back site
hold Garage from the mid side so nobody walks out behind you

Haven.after: Plant safe behind the box. Hold from Logs, Long and Garage; keep one util for the defuse.

Haven.name: B through mid
Haven.idea: Hit the small middle site through Mid Courtyard and Window.

steps.do: smoke B back (CT side) and the Garage door
util through Mid Window onto B site
trade the duelist through the Window

Haven.after: B is small: plant fast, then hold from Courtyard and Window and watch both Links.

Haven.name: Fake A, hit C
Haven.idea: Sell an A hit with a little util, then everyone goes C.

steps.do: use one piece of util at A Long to sell it, then rotate to C
make noise at A Short (Sewer) for 10 seconds, then rotate
save smokes for C: C Link and the Garage door
wait at C Long, first in when smokes land
lurk A Lobby and call any rotations

Haven.after: Only worth it if the fake pulled their util. If A looked empty, take A instead.

Haven.name: Garage take, late C
Haven.idea: Slow round: take mid Courtyard and Garage first, then pinch C from Garage and Long.

steps.do: util on the Garage window, then take Courtyard
take Garage right after the initiator's util
keep smokes for C Link (CT) on the hit
show A Long early, then rotate to C Long
lurk C Long, wait for the Garage call

Haven.after: Hit C with about 45 seconds left; if A players rotate through Link, punish it from Garage.

Haven.name: 2-1-2 default
Haven.idea: Two A, one B, two C. Give up a site if it's five-stacked and retake together.

steps.do: C: hold Garage / C Link with the anchor
B / mid so smokes reach A and C
A Long: info early, then fall back to Heaven

Haven.after: Retake: smoke their entry (Long or Garage) and flash in from two sides together.

Haven.name: Garage push for info
Haven.idea: Two players take mid early to see where they're going.

steps.do: util into mid Courtyard / Garage window
push Garage with the initiator, take one fight, fall back
smoke the Garage window so they can fall back

Haven.after: One fight, then back. Don't die in Garage.

Haven.name: A Long push
Haven.idea: Catch them walking up A Long.

steps.do: swing A Long right after the util
trade from A Long, then fall back
smoke A Long for the fall back

Haven.after: If you get a kill, play it safe: they're one down, don't chase.

Haven.name: C stack
Haven.idea: Three on C after they've hit C a couple of times.

steps.do: B, ready to rotate to C
A alone: info, fall back and call

Haven.after: A gamble. A player alone on A: don't fight, just call and slow them down.

Haven.name: Give A, retake
Haven.idea: Play A light and retake with everyone.

steps.do: B; smoke Long and Short exits for the retake
A: info only, fall back to A Link when they come
A Link: first in on the retake

Haven.after: Retake together through A Link and Heaven; flash in at the same time.
